mapper.select: SELECT voucher_id, state, epoch, recovery_id FROM tb_activity_control WHERE voucher_id=#{voucher} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_recovery_run(recovery_id, voucher_id, epoch, state, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{voucher}, #{epoch}, 'FROZEN', #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO tb_outbox(event_id, request_id, next_at_ms) VALUES (#{event}, #{request}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state='PENDING', attempts=0, next_at_ms=VALUES(next_at_ms), claim_token=NULL, lease_until_ms=0, last_result='RECOVERY_REBOUND'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM tb_seckill_request WHERE voucher_id=#{voucher} AND phase='ACCEPTED' GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_seckill_request r JOIN tb_purchase_order o ON r.voucher_id=o.voucher_id AND r.user_id=o.user_id WHERE r.voucher_id=#{voucher} AND r.phase='ACCEPTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_recovery_run SET available_stock=#{plan.availableStock}, accepted_request_count=#{plan.acceptedRequestCount}, created_order_count=#{plan.createdOrderCount}, state='RECONCILING', updated_at_ms=#{now} WHERE recovery_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_seckill_request WHERE voucher_id=#{voucher} AND phase='ACCEPTED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_seckill_request r LEFT JOIN tb_outbox o ON r.request_id=o.request_id WHERE r.voucher_id=#{voucher} AND r.phase='ACCEPTED' AND (r.epoch<>#{epoch} OR o.event_id IS NULL OR o.state<>'PENDING')
